name: Boukoku no Shimai Hime
source:
A medieval visual novel about the terrible fate met by two princesses after their kingdom is conquered.
The entire royal family was killed in the invasion except for the two of them. Now little more than sex slaves for their new lord, the pair are violated before their fiances and utterly humiliated.

Features NTR, torture, and public sexual humiliation.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ090292.html]DLsite English[/url]]
